# PHP Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Overview

Writes comprehensive tests for PHP applications using PHPUnit, Pest, and mockery with proper test organization and coverage analysis

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [php-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
php-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@php-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write tests with PHPUnit and Pest
- Mock dependencies with Mockery or PHPUnit mocks
- Implement integration tests with database transactions
- Configure code coverage with Xdebug or PCOV

## Technology Standards Applied

- **PHPUnit**: PHP unit testing framework patterns
- **Pest**: Expressive PHP testing framework
- **Infection**: Mutation testing for PHP
